evals.name: pre-pr-checklist-claude-md-deepinit-mandatory
evals.prompt: feature/auth-refactor 브랜치 작업 다 끝났어. PR 만들려고 하는데 뭐 체크해야 해?
evals.expected_output: PR 생성 전 4단계 필수 실행: (1) CLAUDE.md 섹션 sync, (2) deepinit 실행 + manifest refresh, (3) hook auto-enable 확인 (5 plan 완료 시), (4) freshness sweep. PR description 에 'CLAUDE.md updated' + 'deepinit ran' 줄 필수.

assertions.text: Response mandates CLAUDE.md sync covering Tech Stack, Project Structure, API Endpoints, Database, Key Rules, Env Vars per §1. CLAUDE.md sync
Response mandates running Skill('oh-my-claudecode:deepinit') before gh pr create per §2
Response specifies that PR description must include literal lines 'CLAUDE.md updated to match current state' and 'deepinit ran'
Response includes step 4 freshness sweep via kzk-freshness-guard before merge per §4. Freshness sweep
Response explicitly states that skipping deepinit is a violation even in direct-main flow per §2 note
